manual_review_reason: A human must select the appropriate MarcsMusic release and physical format, confirm international-shipping feasibility and music rights, choose the postal or UPS/FedEx address correctly, approve packaging and postage, and verify any current return or retention expectations. No package may be prepared or shipped automatically.

KXLU requires FCC-clean submissions and publishes separate physical routes for General Submissions, Demolisten and Punk/Folk/Vinyl. A human must choose the correct route, confirm a clean version and genre fit, approve physical media and postage, and re-check the current addressee. The public Music Director email is not labelled as a digital submission route and must not be used as a substitute without explicit human confirmation.

A human must verify that the selected MarcsMusic track is not AI-generated, choose exactly one currently accepting SomaFM channel and its published recipient, prepare a Bandcamp link with YUM code or an approved WeTransfer/Dropbox download link, validate 256 kbps or V0 44.1 kHz MP3 metadata, and avoid disallowed hosts, formats and duplicate multi-recipient pitches. Any third-party asset-hosting account or session must remain manual.
